title: C++Now 2018: You Can Do Better than std::unordered_map: New Improvements to Hash Table Performance
summary: Malte Skarupke's C++Now 2018 talk on hash table performance, explaining why std::unordered_map is slow and memory hungry and presenting faster designs, including his bytell hash map.
why: Recommended as a thorough, well-regarded explanation of hash table design tradeoffs and why the standard container is a poor choice.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: Many videos on hash table are great. I found this one particularly good.
